name: Preview Recovery & Browser Responsiveness
changes: Bounds visible-image deferred recovery time and gives it a timed single-lane fallback even if thumbnails remain active.
Converts full-image recovery failures into actionable Retry cards rather than infinite loaders.
Stops deferred thumbnails from being requeued by the demand scanner while their recovery is pending.
Uses constant-time stable article identity checks when building large Image Sets to reduce browser-thread stalls.
regression_guards: v3.7.8 Image Sets recognition, ON/OFF persistence, and Continuous browse state remain unchanged.
v3.7.7 Newsgroups splitter and UI styling remain unchanged.
Thumbnail and download concurrency, SABnzbd 5.1.2, SABCTools 9.6.3 and managed updates remain unchanged.
preserved: NNTP, thumbnail format and server processing, Direct Unpack, PAR2 repair, Automation, Smart Import, Backup & Restore and all themes.
Metadata Server v0.3.3 and Diagnostic Collector v1.0.31 remain unchanged.
